links.outcome: Clinical trial enrollment after AI-triggered oncologist notifications versus no notifications
links.effect: Enrollment 2.20% intervention vs 2.03% control; difference 0.18 percentage points (95% CI -0.25 to 0.58; P = .41). No significant benefit.
links.quote: The intervention had no significant impact on the trial enrollment rate (intervention, 2.20% [95% CI, 1.97%-2.46%]; control, 2.03% [95% CI, 1.72%-2.39%]; difference, 0.18 [95% CI, -0.25 to 0.58] percentage points; P = .41).

unlisted_practices: AI-triggered clinical trial matching notifications to oncologists at time of detected cancer progression

screen.reason: This randomized controlled trial directly evaluated the clinical impact of deploying AI-triggered notifications to oncologists regarding clinical trial matching based on AI interpretation of progression in imaging reports.

primary.practice: AI-triggered clinical trial notifications to oncologists
